title: Starry Sky Dialogue
next_chapter_hook: Just as the hearts of the two began to connect, the prohibition in Ye Qing's sleeve suddenly blazed with dazzling blood light—the Holy Sect's surveillance was far tighter than imagined, and she had little time left.

text.content: The night wind was like silk, causing the scattered stars across the heavens to flicker uncertainly. Chen Ji and Ye Qing stood side by side at the cliff's edge, the noisy voices of those demonic path disciples behind them gradually fading away. Yet that faint blood-colored prohibition light in her sleeve still silently reminded them—that this dialogue might be being watched by some unseen eyes.

dialogue.content: You saw the Holy Sect's 'Heart Lamp', didn't you?

text.content: Ye Qing's voice was very soft, like a whisper meant for the wind. She raised her hand, letting her sleeve drape down, revealing the prohibition device hidden deep within the fabric—a miniature lamp with blood as its wick, now emitting a cold, eerie light.

dialogue.content: The Heart Lamp sustains life by binding the soul.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was unruffled, as if stating an unrelated fact. He didn't look at the lamp but stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes: "Every time you speak a sincere word, it burns a little more. Are you willing to pay that price?"

dialogue.content: (She forced a bitter smile) Otherwise, I wouldn't even have the right to choose.

text.content: Ye Qing turned around, her back to Chen Ji. Starlight fell on her shoulders but revealed a slightly hunched silhouette. She slowly untied a corner of her outer robe, exposing her left shoulder—where there was a pitch-black mark, shaped like a giant eye, identical to the Holy Sect's emblem.

dialogue.content: At six years old, I was waiting to die in a mass grave. The Holy Sect's people found me and said I possessed a 'Yin Spirit Physique', a rare genius for cultivating demonic arts.

text.content: Her voice gradually grew softer, as if turning pages of an old book long sealed in dust. "They fed me the 'Forget-Worry Powder', making me forget my parents' faces. They branded me with the Saintess mark, turning me into a vessel for the Saintess."

The night wind stirred her hair. At this moment, she was no longer the demonic Saintess who made the righteous factions tremble with fear, just a lonely girl toyed with by fate. Chen Ji noticed her fingers gripping her garment, white from tension, her knuckles trembling slightly from the force.

dialogue.content: The so-called Saintess is merely a sacrificial offering. Every ten years, they hold the 'Grand Return Ceremony', draining the Saintess's accumulated cultivation to nourish the Holy Master.
And I have only two years left.

text.content: These words fell lightly, yet resounded like thunder in the night wind. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted—two years. In two years, this woman would become the next sacrifice for 'returning to the source', her cultivation drained before the public eye, transformed into nourishment for the Holy Master.

choice.prompt: Faced with Ye Qing's impending fate of being sacrificed, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Clearly express that he will help her break this destiny, even if it means confronting the Holy Sect head-on
choices.visible_cost: Being pulled into the Holy Sect's vortex
choices.risk_hint: The promise is too heavy, possibly exceeding one's own capabilities

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, the starry sky reflecting cold, sharp light in his eyes. He slowly spoke: "Two years. That is enough."

dialogue.content: I will return this fate to them with my own hands.

choices.description: Do not make reckless promises, but calmly point out the difficulties and variables of rescue
choices.visible_reward: reveal the depth of his strategic acumen
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might think he is merely using her

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he raised his eyes to the night sky as if deducing something. After a long moment, he softly said: "The Holy Sect's Grand Ceremony of Unity requires three guardians to officiate simultaneously, at the fixed location of the Holy Mountain Forbidden Grounds."

dialogue.content: In other words, to save you, I would need to kill all three old monsters. Do you think I have that capability?

choices.description: use the foresight ability of the Tianji Record as a bargaining chip to gain deeper cooperation
choices.visible_cost: expose part of his trump cards
choices.visible_reward: establish a foundation for equal cooperation
choices.risk_hint: exposing the Tianji Record might bring greater troubles

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his hand, pointing at the heart lamp hidden in Ye Qing's sleeve. That faint crimson glow seemed to sense something, and actually began to tremble slightly.

dialogue.content: I can see some things. Events within the next three hours. The cost is great, but I am willing to perform a premonition for you.

flags_set: 天机录能力_向夜清透露
choices.memory_label: 向夜清透露天机录存在

text.content: Ye Qing stared at him blankly. Those eyes, usually shrouded in cold indifference, now actually glistened with a thin layer of moisture. She parted her lips as if wanting to say something, but ultimately only gently shook her head and pulled her outer robe more tightly around herself.

dialogue.content: You know, I have hated many people. I hated the Holy Lord, hated those elders who treated me as a tool, hated this unfair world.
But what I hated most was myself.

text.content: Her voice was like crushed ice crystals, carrying a bone-piercing chill. "I hated myself for not having the courage to die, hated myself for still harboring hope, hated myself for... actually daring to wish that someone could save me."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji spoke calmly) Then what about now?

text.content: Ye Qing turned around, truly examining this disciple of servants from the Tianqing Sect, who was called a "waste". Under the starlight, his features were unremarkable, yet his eyes were as deep as if an infinite star map was hidden within. She suddenly realized she could not see through this person.

dialogue.content: Now... I'm not sure.

choice.prompt: What did Ye Qing's confusion make Chen Ji see?

choices.description: recalling the despair and unwillingness he felt when he was treated as a waste in the Tianqing Sect
choices.risk_hint: possibly exposing his own weak side

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He merely lifted his head, gazing toward that vast river of stars. After a long moment, his voice finally escaped from his throat, as light as a sigh.

dialogue.content: When I was twelve years old, at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, I almost ended my life with a hemp rope.

choices.description: From a bystander's perspective, pointing out that untamed wildness within her that refuses to submit

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly reached out, and in Ye Qing's astonished gaze, pointed to the pitch-black giant eye mark on her left shoulder.

dialogue.content: A true saint maiden would never show such a thing to outsiders. Are you testing me?

choices.description: Calmly analyzing the similarities in their situations, pointing out that both are merely chess pieces being manipulated
choices.visible_reward: Establishing a foundation for cooperation rationally
choices.risk_hint: Might make Ye Qing even more desperate

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, his voice low as a midnight pool: "You hate yourself for clinging to hope, and how am I any different?"

dialogue.content: We are all chess pieces. The only difference is the chessboard.

choices.memory_label: 首次向夜清透露命运观

text.content: Ye Qing froze. She had imagined many possibilities—mockery, sympathy, false comfort. Never had she expected this answer. An indescribable emotion surged in her heart, making her nose faintly tingle. She hastily turned away, pretending to gaze at the distant mountains.

dialogue.content: So... you too have been manipulated by fate?
(Light laugh) Manipulated? I am still being manipulated.

text.content: Ye Qing turned abruptly, and for the first time saw something in this man's eyes similar to her own—a kind of desensitization after经历了沧桑, yet secretly harboring an unextinguished flame. She suddenly understood something.

dialogue.content: So that's why you can endure so much.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He merely stared at the shooting star streaking across the night sky. The night wind whistled through their robes, and at this moment, they were no longer the Demonic Path saint maiden and the righteous path's废物—merely two pitiful souls toyed with by fate.
Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a barely perceptible tremor: "If... I mean, if. Two years later, you truly have the ability to save me... would you require me to repay this favor?"

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Ye Qing's试探 regarding "人情"?

choices.text: Directly stating no repayment is needed
choices.description: Showing that the rescue was not for gain, but simply following the heart.
choices.visible_reward: Completely breaking down Ye Qing's mental defenses.
choices.risk_hint: Might make the other party feel it is insincere.

dialogue.content: Unnecessary.

text.content: Chen Ji's answer was so direct that Ye Qing stood frozen. He gazed at the fading meteor trail, continuing: 'I never do these things expecting repayment.'

choices.memory_label: 首次向夜清表明行事原则

choices.text: Setting up an exchange of interests.
choices.description: Clearly stating that cooperation is two-way, that saving her also requires her to pay a corresponding price.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might retreat because of this.

dialogue.content: Favors of this kind, I never accept.

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, facing Ye Qing's eyes directly: 'But I have one condition — after you survive, you must help me with one thing. One thing that only you can do.'

choices.text: Asking her what she truly wants.
choices.description: Not answering directly, but instead probing the desires deep in her heart.
choices.visible_cost: Might seem like avoiding the question.
choices.visible_reward: Getting to understand Ye Qing deeply.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might be unable to face her inner self.

dialogue.content: More than wanting repayment, I want to know — what do you yourself want?

text.content:
Ye Qing's body stiffened slightly. She opened her mouth, yet found this question harder to answer than any promise.

What did she want? She hadn't thought about this question in a very long time.

Silence spread between the two. The night wind still blew, the blood-light of the Heart Lamp still flickered, but the atmosphere was entirely different from before. Ye Qing lowered her head, gazing at her shadow illuminated by starlight, and suddenly softly said:

dialogue.content: I want... to see the outside world.

text.content: These words were as light as a murmur, yet they made Chen Ji's heart jolt violently. He remembered the blurry image he had seen in the Tianji Record — a white-clad woman walking alone amid the vast yellow sands, her smile bright as the first light of spring. The figure in that image had never had a face. Until now.

dialogue.content: There are no scenic views in the Holy Sect, only endless schemes and slaughter. I don't even know... what color the sunrise is.
(Softly said) The sunrise is golden. It stings the eyes, but it's warm.

text.content:
Ye Qing raised her head sharply, her eyes shining with a light Chen Ji had never seen before. In that moment, all the coldness and pretense on her face fell away, leaving only the purest longing of a young girl for freedom.

She suddenly laughed—a genuine, unrestrained smile.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, you're the first... person willing to talk to me like this.

text.content:
Chen Ji said nothing. He simply stood there quietly, letting the night wind scatter the hair across his brow. Moonlight bathed his profile, sketching a gentle yet elusive outline. He suddenly thought: if the Tianji Record's ultimate mission was to peer into heavenly secrets, did those heavenly secrets also include—

granting those trapped by fate... the right to choose?

A sharp whistle suddenly pierced the air from the distance—the gathering signal of the Demonic Path disciples. Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly as she looked down at the Heart Lamp hidden in her sleeve, its crimson glow trembling violently as if transmitting some message.

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect disciples... are arriving.

(Chen Ji calmly straightened his robes) Our conversation should end.

But some things... can be approached gradually.

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at him deeply, her eyes filled with complex emotions—gratitude, confusion, a hint of lingering dependence, and... a kind of flutter she herself could not explain. She took a deep breath and drew her outer robe tighter, that icy expression creeping back across her face once more, as if everything just moments ago was merely an illusory dream.

Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice soft but clearly reaching Ye Qing's ears: "Two years."

Ye Qing's steps faltered.

"Remember this number." Chen Ji did not turn around. "In two years, I will wait for you at the foot of the Sacred Mountain. By then—"

He paused, starlight refracting strange brilliance in his eyes.

"By then, I'll take you to watch the sunrise."
